about.title: Oxnard Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a death in Oxnard is caused by someone else's carelessness, the people left behind carry more than grief. There are funeral bills, a paycheck that no longer arrives, and an empty chair that no legal process can fill. California law recognizes that loss. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, kept separate from any criminal case, and it belongs first to the spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. Oxnard recorded 8 traffic deaths in 2025, many on familiar streets such as Oxnard Boulevard, Rose Avenue, Saviers Road and Ventura Road, though fatal harm also happens in workplaces, hospitals and homes. Whatever the cause, the deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that matches Ventura County families with an independent attorney who handles these claims on contingency, so you owe nothing unless there is a recovery.

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to the spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you are matched with can sort out who belongs on the claim before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Families in Ventura County generally have two years from the date of death, but that window is much shorter when a city, county or state agency may be responsible. Reaching out sooner protects your right to be heard.

items.title: Every category of loss accounted for
items.desc: A wrongful death claim can cover funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Nothing is owed unless the attorney recovers for you.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on Rose Avenue and the driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution in Ventura County, and the two have different standards of proof. Families often move forward on the civil side while the criminal case is still pending, partly because evidence like vehicle data and witness accounts is easier to preserve early. The attorney you are connected with can explain how the two proceedings interact.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law gives the first right to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children. If there is no one in that group, certain dependents and other heirs may be able to bring the claim. Because only one action is typically filed on behalf of everyone with standing, it helps to identify all eligible family members at the outset.

items.question: What if a city vehicle or a poorly maintained public road played a role in the death?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California follow a much shorter timeline than the standard two years from the date of death, and a formal claim usually has to be presented before a lawsuit can proceed. Missing that early step can close the door entirely. If you suspect a public agency is involved anywhere in Oxnard, it is worth speaking with an attorney right away.
